attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2801/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No year, so no `dates` object; no place named, so no coordinate. None of the fifteen Anastasius folders the corpus holds is kept on this day or has this story.
